identity.title: Imaging the water snow-line during a protostellar outburst

evidence.quote: It is located in the Orion Nebula Cluster, which has a distance of 414$\pm$7 pc$^{[18]}$.

question.value: Can the water snow-line be imaged in the disk of the outbursting protostar V883 Ori, and what does the dust optical depth and spectral index across it reveal?

evidence.quote: We find an intensity break corresponding to an abrupt change in the optical depth at about 42 au, where the elevated disk temperature approaches the condensation point of water

analysis_steps.goal: Grey-body fit for tau and T_s

method.value: I_nu = B_nu(T_s)[1-exp(tau)] with tau=tau0 (nu/nu0)^beta, nu0=218 GHz

evidence.quote: where the optical depth $\tau (a)$ = $\tau_0 \times (\nu/\nu_0)^{\beta}$ and T$_s$ is the average dust temperature along the line of sight

assumptions.value: beta = 1.0; T_s ∝ 1/sqrt(a) extrapolated from region where tau=3

evidence.quote: We therefore adopt a temperature profile with $T_s \propto 1/ \sqrt{a}$ extrapolated from the region where $\tau$=3.

validation.value: Result insensitive to beta and to prescription beyond 0.1''

evidence.quote: This result is robust and insensitive to $\beta$ and to the exact prescription used to estimate $\tau$ and $T_s$ beyond 0.1$"$.

claims.hypothesis: The outburst has pushed the water snow-line outward in V883 Ori and it can be imaged
claims.experiment: 0.03'' 1.3 mm continuum, two-window spectral index, grey-body fits
claims.result: Intensity break at ~42 au with alpha rising from 2.0 to 3.7 and T≈105 K

evidence.quote: from which we conclude that the outburst has moved the water snow-line.

claims.hypothesis: Spectral behaviour matches dust fragmentation models
claims.experiment: Compare alpha and tau profiles with Banzatti et al. models
claims.result: alpha increases and tau drops steeply near snow-line

evidence.quote: In their models, $\alpha$ increases and $\tau$ decreases steeply around the water snow-line, in remarkably good agreement with our observational results.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CLEAN-based matched maps vs Bayesian image synthesis; Bayesian adopted for finer detail and more homogeneous residuals

limitations_admitted.value: Temperature is an extrapolation from the optically thick surface and may underestimate midplane snow-line temperature; tau0 and Ts degenerate when optically thin

evidence.quote: our temperature estimate is based on an extrapolation from the surface of the optically thick inner disk and might underestimate the true temperature

referee_caveats_inferred: Only two frequency points, beta fixed at 1
105 K is lower than expected water sublimation temperature in disks; relies on pressure argument
Dynamical mass error dominated by distance; Rd degenerate
Break could have other origins (e.g. dust properties not tied to water)
